name: io.github.markl-a/spectyn-mesh
title: Spectyn Mesh
description: Self-hostable AI agent runtime: 40+ MCP tools over stdio + distributed swarm/evolve.

packageArguments.description: Subcommand that starts the MCP stdio server (newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdin/stdout).

environmentVariables.name: SPECTYN_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Override the runtime data directory. Defaults to ~/.spectyn-mesh. Stores agents.toml, memory.json, diag ring, and autoevolve.log.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only needed if the host agent calls spectyn_swarm / spectyn_evolve_distributed and an OpenAI-backed agent is configured in agents.toml. Other providers (Anthropic, Groq, Gemini, Mistral, etc.) have their own *_API_KEY variables — see agents.toml docs.

host.description: Host:port of a spectyn serve instance that the operator has stood up themselves (e.g. 'spectyn.example.com' or a Tailscale magic-DNS name like 'coord.tail-net.ts.net:7878'). spectyn-mesh does NOT operate a hosted endpoint — every user runs their own coordinator. Use the mcpb package above for the zero-infra path.

highlights: Sandbox-aware tool surface: iOS build drops fork/exec tools automatically; tools/list reflects the host platform.
Cluster-native: spectyn_swarm fans a prompt to every reachable peer in the user's Tailscale mesh and synthesizes the results.
spectyn_evolve_distributed decomposes a goal into subtasks, runs them across the cluster, and returns a merged answer.
subagent / parallel_tasks tools let the host model spawn additional configured agents (master, coder, reviewer, researcher) with per-call budget caps.
diag_read exposes the daemon's own diagnostic ring + crash logs — useful for self-debugging hosts.
